counterexamples.finding: Small-sample normal approximation changes a threshold decision
counterexamples.synthetic_result: At n=15 and t=2, the legacy normal-tail p is about 0.04550; independent numerical integration of Student t with 13 degrees of freedom gives about 0.06684.

statistical_limits: Even a corrected iid-normal reference test does not establish the assumptions for dependent time-series lag searches. Separate benchmark and pair corrections do not support the page claim of one common family. Correlations and substring sibling matching do not establish causal ancestry or independent evidence.

primary_references.supports: Pearson reference-test assumptions, exact correlation distribution, and undefined constant inputs.
BH error-control conditions require independent tests or specified positive dependence; arbitrary dependence requires different guarantees.
